# British Chamber of Commerce Singapore

> The leading business networking organization connecting British and international companies with opportunities across Singapore and Southeast Asia.

BritCham Singapore has served as a cornerstone of UK-Singapore business relations since 1954, supporting over 3,600 senior professionals through networking events, trade acceleration programs, and market entry guidance. The chamber provides comprehensive resources for doing business in ASEAN, operates CBD facilities, and facilitates connections through the broader British Chambers of Commerce Global Network.

## Key Topics

- British Chamber of Commerce Singapore

## About the Chamber

- [British Chamber Of Commerce Singapore](https://britcham.org.sg): Homepage for British Chamber of Commerce Singapore with membership, events, and trade accelerator information
- [ABOUT THE CHAMBER | British Chamber Of Commerce Singapore](https://britcham.org.sg/about-chamber): Overview of British Chamber of Commerce Singapore mission, history since 1954, and business ecosystem
- [MESSAGE FROM OUR PATRON | British Chamber Of Commerce Singapore](https://britcham.org.sg/message-our-patron): Message from British High Commissioner on UK-Singapore and ASEAN business support
- [MANAGEMENT TEAM | British Chamber Of Commerce Singapore](https://britcham.org.sg/management-team): Chamber management team and staff directory with department contact information

## Business Opportunities & Services

- [DOING BUSINESS IN ASEAN | British Chamber Of Commerce Singapore](https://britcham.org.sg/doing-business-in-singapore-and-asean): Guide to ASEAN market entry and Southeast Asia business expansion opportunities
- [ADVERTISE WITH US | British Chamber Of Commerce Singapore](https://britcham.org.sg/advertising): Advertising and sponsorship opportunities targeting 3,600+ senior professionals in Singapore
- [SPONSORSHIP OPPORTUNITIES | British Chamber Of Commerce Singapore](https://britcham.org.sg/sponsorship-opportunities): Corporate sponsorship programs for brand positioning and business networking opportunities
- [USING THE CHAMBER FACILITIES | British Chamber Of Commerce Singapore](https://britcham.org.sg/chamber-facilities): Office space rental in CBD including boardroom, meeting rooms, and hot desk facilities
